scenario: Seated pipe with the main power off: largest 0.5 s deceleration into the nip retained at the softest accepted tread
basis: A robot that is not driving stops no harder than its tyres grip, taken as 1.5 g; the limit is twice that because a suddenly applied load can reach twice its static value. With the main power off the gearbox coasts and the pipe is held by the tread squeeze: 24/24 required cases retained over 40-160 N/mm (a 1.5 g stop for 0.5 s and an 8 g, 50 ms hit, main power off and brake idle mode), largest travel into the nip 3.79 mm. At 40 N/mm with the power off: sustained 6 g kept, 8 g lost; 50 ms hit 16 g kept, 24 g lost. Static push-through 71.8 N at 40 N/mm against a 14.2 N stop load. Control: rollers decoupled on a 20 N/mm tread lose the pipe at 8 g.
